//: Composite indexes. Firestore creates single-field indexes on its own, but a query that combines an equality filter with an orderBy on a DIFFERENT field needs one of these declared, or it fails at runtime with FAILED_PRECONDITION. Deploy with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes

indexes.//: listMyWholesaleOrders() in app/lib/wholesale.ts: where('accountUid','==',uid) + orderBy('createdAt','desc'). The accountUid filter is not optional — the wholesaleOrders read rule requires it, so this exact shape is the only way a shop can read its own orders.
